title: Compatible ordinary and derived presentations of the coefficient adjunction
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and a scheme W on which l is invertible, with the project's independent universes and ordinary unbounded derived module categories. Use the fixed scalar-extension and coefficient-sequence functors. With OrdinaryModel and DerivedModel exactly as defined in [def-trf-completion-unit-models], there exist a coherent coefficient calculus S [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], its coherence witness, an OrdinaryModel M, and a DerivedModel for S and M. This is only the simultaneous construction and comparison-normalization assertion: it asserts no cone-augmentation formula, two-resolution unit formula or representative-independence theorem.

The specified normalizations are the coefficient specialization in original completion-unit proof steps 1--4, not a verbatim assertion of these tags.

proof.text: Choose S and its coherence by coefficientDerivedSystemEvaluationCalculus and choose the ordinary tensor adjunction M by ordinaryModel_exists. These are independent inputs, not choices extracted into definitions.

Build the termwise-limit cone and prove it limiting by evaluation in each degree. Its unique comparison to the chosen limit is natural and has the prescribed projections. Whisker the canonical right-derived unit of lim with the inverse comparison. Cancel the homotopy localization factor isomorphisms and rightDerivedFunctorUnit to prove the K-injective normalization. Transport the K-injective derivability property through the comparison, obtaining the right-derived universal property.

Exact pro-etale products allow strictRoosDerivation. Uniqueness of right derived functors gives an isomorphism from its derived functor to the fixed coefficientConstantTowerLimit. Compose this with its localization isomorphism. The universal right-derived comparison equation gives Q(roos inclusion) followed by this isomorphism equal to the canonical unit.

Apply derivedAdjunctionComparison_exists with S, its original coherence, M, the canonical termwise comparison and its normalized right-derived unit. Assemble its reduction comparison, evaluation and Hom equations with the proven tower and Roos comparisons into DerivedModel. The system unit is the actual composite systemLimitUnit; its composition field holds by the definition of the natural transformation.

proof_origin.place: 07A6, 0D6E, 0941 and derived.tex 09T5. P4 reduction: ordinary adjunction and normalized derived tensor comparison are separate steps; termwise limit, canonical unit normalization and strict Roos comparison are proved in Lean.
